transcript.text: Hello, I'm here to help you get ready for your appointment. Could you tell me what has been bothering you?
It's my lower back — it's been giving me a lot of grief. Aching and stiff, and it's stopping me from doing the gardening.
When did you first notice it?
It came on out of nowhere about a month ago.
Is there anything that makes it better or worse?
Bending and getting out of the car make it worse. It eases if I lie on my side, and a hot water bottle helps too.
How would you describe the feeling in your own words?
It's a stiff, aching pain most of the time, with the odd sharp twinge.
Where exactly do you feel it, and does it spread anywhere?
It's across my lower back, more on the left side, and it spreads into my left buttock. It doesn't go below my knee though.
On a scale from 0 to 10, where 10 is the worst, how bad is it?
I'd say about a 6 out of 10. It's worst first thing in the morning.
Is it there all the time, or does it come and go?
The aching is there most of the time, but the sharp twinges come and go.
Has anything else been bothering you along with this?

No, nothing else really. I've had no numbness around the back passage or groin, no trouble passing urine or controlling my bowels, and my legs feel fine — no weakness. No fever either, and I haven't lost any weight.
Do you see a doctor regularly for any health condition?
Yes, I have type 2 diabetes, so I'm on medication for that.
Which medicines do you take regularly, including any new ones?
I take gliclazide 80 mg twice a day and metformin 1 g twice a day for the diabetes. And since the back pain started I've been taking ibuprofen 400 mg three times a day, which I got from the chemist.
Are you allergic to any medicines?
No, I'm not allergic to anything as far as I know.
Has this changed what you can do around the house or outside?
Yes, I can't do any gardening at all now. And I need help putting my socks on, which is a bit humbling.
Is there anything about this that worries you?
I suppose my main worry is whether I've slipped a disc — and whether I need a scan for it.
Thank you, that is very helpful. I have put together a short summary of what you told me. Please read it and tell me if anything should be corrected before it goes to your doctor.
